scope: Shared footer CSS only; required changelog and real local browser evidence accompany it.
observedSymptom: At 820 touch, 44px Explore links have 28.8125px row pitch. The bottom-center of Encoding & Codecs hits General Tools and navigates to /category/general-tools.
minimalReproduction: Open /about at 820x1180 with touch, scroll to the footer, activate Encoding & Codecs at its bottom-center. Expected: /category/encoding-codecs. Reported actual: /category/general-tools.
singleRootCause: client/src/styles/shell/footer.css sets margin-block:-7.6px on flex-column Explore anchors and margin-top:-11.6px on the first row, compressing the layout advance below the 44px hit rectangle.
fix: Remove both negative-margin declarations; keep min-height:44px, centered text, existing 13px typography, category ordering, responsive grid and focus ring.
priorFailedApproaches: None attempted in this run. No z-index, pointer-events, artificial targets or application data substitutions will be used.

runtime.database: Dedicated local PostgreSQL awesome_c6_ps065, cloned from local awesome_c2_pubsec

acceptance: At 1440 desktop, 820 touch and 390 touch, all Explore targets are at least 44px high and no two visible footer target rectangles intersect
At each width, bottom-center Encoding and top-center General activate their own category routes via real pointer/touch input
At each width, keyboard Tab and Shift+Tab preserve DOM order, visible focus and Enter activation
At each width, document scroll width does not exceed viewport width
